verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents mail forwarding as a plan feature, package shipping to any address, and self-serve requests to have mail shipped instead of scanned. It also documents generic automation rules, though these are not explicitly tied to forwarding. Missing for 10: saved recipient/address book, carrier selection, cost shown before confirmation, explicit one-click forwarding UI, forwarding-specific rule configuration, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I can forward mail with rules or one click — saved recipients, carrier choice, and cost shown before I confirm — rather than emailing support
